q: What does “unlimited graphic design” and “unlimited video design”mean?
a: Kimp’s unlimited graphic design and unlimited video design service includes unlimited requests and unlimited revisions. This means that you can make as many requests as you’d like, and we’ll work through them as quickly as possible. Once you submit your requests, your dedicated Project Manager will review them, to ensure we have all the details required. Then they’ll assign them to your design team.

By default, your requests will be completed in the order you submit them on KIMP360. But if you ever need to change the order, or prioritize a certain task, or tasks, you can do so by letting our Project Manager know.
We work on your requests on a first-come, first-served basis. They are entered into your design team’s queue in the order that they are received. Your team then works on delivering them.

On average you’ll receive designs or revisions in 24 hours with the Kimp Graphics subscription (this applies to designs like social media posts, web banners, and single-sided print designs). And on average you’ll receive 1 30-60 second animated video, every 24 hours or 1 10 minute video edit every 2-4 business days, with the Kimp Video subscription. If you’ve got a more complex task, let us know and we’ll provide an estimate on how long it’ll take.
Keep in mind we can work on video edits and audiograms of up to 1 hour long and for all other video types we can work on tasks of up to 3 minutes long.

If you have the Kimp Graphics+Video subscription your turnarounds will be exactly the same. This means that graphics have their own specific turnaround times and videos have their own, so they don’t overlap (e.g. if you have fewer graphic design requests one week, your video requests would still be completed at the same rate as usual, as it’s still the same team completing them. Or vice versa.)

As we work together, and get to know your brand(s) and vision better, the review and revision process will get faster and faster. So you’ll be able to get an increasing number of design projects completed, and only ever pay our flat monthly fee if you have a month-to-month subscription (or our flat quarterly, bi-annual, or annual fee if you have one of our longer term subscriptions).

Kimp Graphics is our most popular subscription, and for good reason! It gives you a wide range of print and digital designs – essentially everything that you’ll need for your day-to-day marketing needs, for our lowest flat monthly fee, on a month-to-month subscription (or our lowest flat quarterly, bi-annual, or annual fee if you have one of our longer term subscriptions). It ALSO includes Custom Illustrations, Landing Pages and UI Designs, and Animated GIFs for the bigger campaigns, or unique projects that you need to tackle.

Kimp Video is our video design and motion graphics subscription. With Kimp Video you can get help enhancing your existing video footage or images, or we’ll design and animate from scratch for you! We provide this range of design and animation services as part of Kimp Video because we know that your video content needs will be dynamic, depending on whether you’re creating something for your website, an email campaign, social media, or something in between. And we’re prepared to deliver a wide range of videos to help you with that.

Kimp Graphics+Video includes all the features of Kimp Graphics and all the features of Kimp Video, for a discounted flat monthly fee, on a month-to-month subscription (or a flat quarterly, bi-annual, or annual fee if you have one of our longer term subscriptions). q: Who works on my requests?
a: Your dedicated design team does! Your team is made up of 1 Project Manager and 3 designers who specialize in different types of design. Based on what you need, your Project Manager will assign your request to the designer best suited to complete it. Once that request is completed, we then move on to your next request. We fulfill your requests 3 at a time for the Graphics plan, 2 at a time for the Video plan and 5 at a time (3 graphics + 2 video) for the Graphics + Video plan, on a first-requested, first-fulfilled basis. This way you get what you need first, the fastest. If the priority of your requests ever shifts, after you’ve made a request, you can just let your project manager know. They will hit pause on your active requests if possible, and fulfill the task(s) that have become more time-sensitive.

q: Do you design with AI?
a: Yes, our designers use AI in their workflows as a creative assistant, not a replacement. We leverage AI to streamline parts of our workflow, speed up execution, and explore ideas more efficiently. Every design is still guided by a human designer’s creative vision, strategic thinking, and attention to detail. The result is faster turnaround times without sacrificing originality, judgment, or the human touch that great design requires.

We also incorporate AI components into our design project management software, KIMP360. From our AI-powered design request form, to text to voiceover generator and more, we build and roll out features based on our clients’ needs.

q: How does the trial work?
a: You sign up, you try us out for 7 days, and you cancel if you decide it’s not the right fit. You are not billed during the trial period. You get billed only after day 7 and you don’t have to sign any contracts to continue with Kimp. Our service is delivered month-to-month for a flat monthly rate. We also offer quarterly, bi-annual and annual subscriptions, with further discounted flat fee pricing (drop us a line on the live chat to find out more!).
So why do we collect payment details when you sign up? To ensure we are only onboarding clients who are seriously considering our service.
Below are guidelines for the Kimp Video and Kimp Graphics Trials, as well as some tips to help you determine if Kimp is right for you.
If you sign up for the Graphics+Video subscription, you will be able to make 1 video request and 3 design requests as per the guidelines below:

list: They often include vague creative briefs as brand guidelines are not available. This in turn doesn’t provide enough direction to complete designs and/or revisions with.

They often require input and feedback from several team members or other stakeholders, which delays the design process and prevents us from being able to provide completed outputs to assess Kimp with.
We’ve also found that many clients who request mascots and characters during the trial are simply seeking branding work on a complimentary basis, and don’t have recurring design needs.

We limit illustration, UI design requests and multi-page/screen requests during trials for the following reasons:

q: Can you create print-ready designs?
a: We absolutely can!
Just be sure to provide these details when making your print requests:

list: Specify whether you need crop/trim marks added.
And specify the bleed size if you or your printer has a preference. Or, if they don’t, ask the Kimp team to recommend and apply a bleed based on the dimensions of the design.

a: Once you receive your files please double check that all of the requirements, as per your brief and your printer’s specifications, have been met, before you proceed with printing.

q: How many tasks will my team work on each day?
a: As part of the Kimp Graphics subscription your Dedicated Design Team will have 3 tasks in progress for you at any given time, and they will allocate 2-2.5 hours each business day to completing your requests.

As part of the Kimp Video subscription your Dedicated Design Team will have 2 tasks in progress for you at any given time, and they will allocate 2-2.5 hours each business day to completing your requests.

With the Graphics + Video subscription, your Dedicated Design Team will have 3 graphic design requests and 2 video requests in progress at any given time. This means that they will allocate 2-2.5 hours each business day to your graphic design requests and 2-2.5 hours each business day to your video design requests.

Now if you need a higher volume of outputs, and faster turnarounds, you can add on additional subscriptions. And this will mean that with each additional Kimp Graphics or Kimp Video subscription, you’ll get an additional 2-2.5 hours allocated to completing your requests (e.g. with 2 subscriptions you’ll get 4-5 hours allocated to your requests, and so forth).

In the case of Kimp Graphics+Video subscriptions, with each additional subscription, you’ll get an additional 2-2.5 hours allocated to your graphic design requests AND an additional 2-2.5 hours allocated to your video design requests.
As your team completes tasks you’ll see them shift from being “In Progress” to “In Review” and you’ll see new requests getting started.

q: Do you use design templates?
a: At Kimp, we deliver custom designs, created from scratch, or designs that are a combination of custom design and customized stock elements. The particular format just depends on what will provide the best output for the client’s brief.
When using any stock elements, we ensure that they are licensed appropriately so that you may use them as the end-user (i.e. not for resale).
In cases where clients require designs for resale, we deliver completely custom designs. So be sure to let your Project Manager know how your designs will be used when making your requests!

q: Can I resell any of the designs Kimp creates for me?
a: If you would like to resell any of the designs that your Kimp Team creates for you, please be sure to let your Project Manager know when making your design request. Your team will then create your design from scratch, so that you have full rights to sell your design.

For all of your other design requests, where you’ll be the end-user, and you will not be reselling your design, your team will either create the design from scratch and/or use stock elements or photos, as needed to meet the requirements of your brief.

Just remember, we double-check every element and stock photo we use, to make sure you’re granted the licenses to use them as the end-user. And we are assuming materials you provide to us are licensed and owned by you. If you do happen to send Kimp unlicensed materials to use, remember we are not held liable for the rights of the final design.

q: Tell me more about your team. Where are they located?
a: Kimp’s HQ is in Markham, Ontario, Canada and operates in EST. Our design team members, meanwhile, are full-time Kimp employees, who work remotely in different time zones. Together we ensure that our clients get timely responses to their inquiries, and have their design requests fulfilled as quickly as they need them to be.

Kimp does not outsource work, or work with freelancers, as an important part of our service is being able to provide consistently high-quality designs to our clients. We also believe in the importance of building strong teams and creating environments that they can thrive in. Because we love giving our team members the opportunity to go bananas with graphic design too 🙂

With each additional subscription that you add, you’ll increase the number of outputs you receive, and the speed at which you receive them. For example, one additional subscription will double the designs you get completed each business day.
